close_reason: Landed in e3d271d. Extracted private fn validate(&str) -> Result<(), Sha256DigestError> shared by from_hex (clones) and TryFrom<String> (moves). TryFrom<String> now validates the owned String, then constructs Self(s) without re-allocating. Test asserts pointer identity between the input String's buffer and the resulting Sha256's as_str() bytes — direct evidence of the move, not just value equality. Hot-path improvement on every Sha256 deserialize via #[serde(try_from = String)].
title: Sha256 TryFrom<String> discards owned String and re-clones via from_hex — clone-to-escape-the-borrow-checker
